businessHours: Monday to Friday, 9am to 5pm US Eastern Time

damagedItems.noReturnNeeded: you do not need to post a damaged item back to us unless we specifically ask
damagedItems.photoNote: a photo of the damage helps us pack better next time, but a photo is not required to approve your claim
damagedItems.policy: for items that arrive damaged, you can choose a free replacement or a full refund

refunds.exceptions: personalised and final-sale items cannot be refunded unless they arrive damaged
refunds.rules: refunds go back to the original payment method only
refunds.timeline: approved refunds are issued within 5 business days of us receiving the returned item, or within 5 business days of an approved cancellation

returns.addressNote: do not send returns to the address on the original shipping box; use the label we email you
returns.conditions: items must be unused, in their original packaging, and returned within the window above
returns.label: we email a prepaid return label for orders shipped within the United States

shipping.domesticDelivery: 3 to 5 business days within the United States
shipping.internationalDelivery: 7 to 14 business days outside the United States
shipping.processingTime: orders are packed and handed to the carrier within 2 business days of purchase
shipping.trackingNote: a tracking link is emailed as soon as the carrier scans the parcel
